high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the verified account "@gazanotice" on the platform X (formerly known as Twitter). The tweet is titled "BREAKING: Palestinian journalist and activist Saleh al-Ja'frawi has been confirmed killed in Gaza." The content of the tweet provides additional context about Saleh al-Ja'frawi's background and the circumstances surrounding his death. It states that he had previously received direct Israeli threats as part of a campaign targeting journalists who exposed the Israeli army's crimes during the war.
